info.title: AGRIMAN Farm Management - Users & Settings API
info.description: Backend APIs for Settings -> Users, Roles & Permissions, Company Settings, Audit Logs, and Authentication.

get.summary: Track administrative actions and system modifications

post.summary: Authenticates user and generates JWT token and refresh token
Refresh access token using refresh token
Validates email and sends a 6-digit OTP to the valid registered email address
Verifies 6-digit OTP sent to user's email and issues a reset token
Resets password using verified token or OTP

get.summary: Get organization details and company settings

put.summary: Update organization details and company settings

get.summary: Track user logins, failed login attempts, IP addresses, and timestamps
Get all system permissions grouped by module
Get all available roles in the system

delete.summary: Delete a role (only if no users are assigned)

get.summary: List users with pagination, search, role and status filtering
Get user statistics (total, active, inactive) calculated dynamically from SQL Server
Get permissions assigned to a user (via their roles and direct permissions)

put.summary: Save/update access permissions for an individual user

post.summary: Update user profile photo (Base64 data URL or photo URL)
Upload user profile photo file (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP)

get.summary: View login history for a specific user
